svg.title: System context — proposed browser-game platform
svg.desc: The author and optional external model provider surround a proposed product boundary. Browser authoring and local play, the independently validating platform service, generation worker and managed infrastructure are internal components. Provider output and worker candidates remain untrusted until the publication gate approves data.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Author
Writer, teacher or small-team member

div.style: color: rgb(63, 38, 30) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
External model provider
Optional; outside product boundary

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Browser client
Authoring and trusted 2D runtime
Gameplay state stays local

div.style: color: rgb(23, 56, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Platform service
Projects, versions and job status
Independent validation and publication gate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Generation service
Intent, candidate data and bounded repair
Output remains untrusted at platform gate

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Managed infrastructure
Project/job records and events
Private approved artifacts
